release_notes.zh-TW: 修復：安裝路徑含空白時更新會在重啟前失敗（出現「Windows 找不到 F:\Program」），更新檔已無法複製到安裝目錄。
release_notes.zh-CN: 修复：安装路径含空白时更新会在重启前失败（出现「Windows 找不到 F:\Program」），更新文件无法复制到安装目录。
release_notes.en: Fixed: when the install path contained a space, the update failed before restarting (Windows could not find "F:\Program") and the new files were never copied into the install folder.
